items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: I know them, like Jeilly Roll Morton and all them famous names, I was agasp about meeting such important great musicians.

ctx.x: Those are later years, yeh Okay, let's see, how did you end up in New York?

Well, we'll start from Celestin. From Dothan, Alabama, I left the band when my money came from my land in Arizona, and I bought a bus ticket clear to New York. When I got into New York I asked where the musicians hang out. Naturally I asked the black musicians say, well, they always hang out at the Rhythm Club, that's around 140th and 7th Avenue. So here I am up in the Rhythm Club, I got me a hotel, I'm hanging around, and I see famous musicians there but I was reluctant to form an acquaintance because they don't…
